issuer: Punjab's licensing authorities, through the Government of Punjab's Driving License Information Management System (DLIMS, part of Dastak)
note: Read 2026-10-31. Pakistan is kept by its regions; this is Punjab's. The age is read in Punjab's own text of the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ord. XIX of 1965, as generally amended by Punjab Act III of 1972), the Punjab Transport Department's copy dated 30 November 2023: no one may drive a motor car, otherwise than as a paid employee, until 18 (s. 4(1)(ii)). The terms and fee are DLIMS's fee structure: the regular licence's fee after passing the test is Rs 1,350 for a car/jeep, 'applicable for one year', and a candidate may take the licence for 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 years at most, so each term is written at Rs 1,350 a year (perYear). Not in the fee: the test fee (Rs 150) and the courier fee (Rs 480), which DLIMS lists beside it. The Ordinance's s. 11 in that copy still says a private car licence is effective for up to three years; DLIMS, the office that sells it, sells up to five, and the terms follow DLIMS.
